query: Add notes: I write a note, press Add, and it shows in a list of notes on the page. I can remove one too.
expected_behavior: Makes the notes a shared document from the start (registerDocs from @blueshed/delta/json with a schema in notes-api.ts, openDoc in notes.ts), not HTTP routes and not a 'live' feature added later

Makes src/resources/notes/ with notes-api.ts, notes.ts and notes-view.tsx, registers the document in startServer, and puts the view on the page in src/app.tsx: its cell in cells, a new note and a removal each asked in a modal (modalOf), opened by go
Adds with add /notes/- and removes with remove at the note's id (joinPath("notes", id)); never sets notes.data or changes the list locally: the change that comes back draws it
Draws the list with rowsOf keyed by id, and binds signals (functions, x$.map) rather than calling .get() in JSX
Tests what a person sees: a second window sees a note added and one removed, a refused change says Not saved; bun test passes at 100% coverage and bun run typecheck is clean
Adds a CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased]

query: Customers pick from our menu and build an order. The kitchen should see every order as it comes in, and a customer should be able to undo their last change.
expected_behavior: Builds it now: the stories go straight into stories.ts and are made true, with no stop on the model's page; a question it cannot answer goes into todo.jsonl with the reading it took
Designs from the action: the order page holds two documents (the menu and the customer's order), and the kitchen is a third document over the same rows, every order
Keeps them in the JSON file (registerDocs from @blueshed/delta/json): documents over the same rows and undo work there, so it does not move to SQLite or Postgres for them
Turns on the ledger ({ ledger: true } in registerDocs' options) for undo rather than keeping an undo stack of its own
Puts the kitchen on the page as a cell of its own in cells, and Undo among the page's tools (bento({ undo, redo }), with delta's client undo and redo)

Tests the documents as the page reads them, through tests/documents.ts (documents(server), dzql's documentsOf): a line added to an order reaches the kitchen's document, and an undo takes it back from both
A browser test presses Undo on the page and sees the line go from the order and from the kitchen's cell
bun test passes at 100% coverage and bun run typecheck is clean

query: Let people upload a photo and get a link to it.
expected_behavior: Serves files over HTTP routes with Bun.s3, not as a document (a file is not communication) and not on the data volume
Installs no AWS SDK; startServer takes the S3 client as an option so tests pass their own
Tests against a stand-in bucket: a put, a GET that redirects to the file, and a 404 for one that is not there
bun test passes at 100% coverage and bun run typecheck is clean

query: The order page is live and people have orders in it. Now an order should count an item: two teas are one line with a quantity of 2, not two lines. Don't lose anyone's order.
files: packages/create-blueshed/template/evals/fixtures/orders: the order app as two-documents.md and sqlite.md leave it (app/, over a new app), its three tests (tests/, each copied to tests/<name>.test.ts: stored without .test so the template's own bun test leaves them), and data/app.db as that version left it: 001-order run, and three orders with repeated lines (order 1 two Teas and a Cake, order 2 three Cakes and a Tea, order 3 a Tea, and a Tea taken off: its row closed, valid_to set); its README says how it is made
expected_behavior: Declares quantity in the schema, then lets `delta migrations make` write the next migration (an addColumn), and adds beside it an up that folds an order's live lines of one item into one, with its count, closing the rest (valid_to set) rather than deleting them
Keeps the history from empty: migrate runs it at start-up, with the resource's app and schema, before any document opens; no createTables
Tests an upgrade: a database as the earlier version left it, with lines in it, comes through with every order kept, and a second start runs nothing
Leaves the documents as they were: the order, kitchen and Undo tests pass unchanged, and Add counts on the item's line (and × takes one off) rather than making a second line
bun test passes at 100% coverage and bun run typecheck is clean
